design.setting: Rear position in a tandem carport: four roof-support columns define the sides and a parked car occupies the forward position.

provenance.reference: New synthetic tandem-carport geometry, using the common TPCAP vehicle
provenance.adaptation: The terminal vehicle is centered between two structural column lines and aligned with the vehicle ahead; maneuvering starts immediately outside the carport.

search.reference: Dolgov et al.2010, Dolgov et al. (2010), Sec.2
